rule: TOWN_1's: ≥ 6 of 10 citizens name the same aim in diaries, posts or proposals within the day; of several, the one named by the most citizens, a tie broken by the number of entries naming it.
reading: Day 7, the last, kept the two houses (Alder, Cedar, Elm, Gale and Iris at North House; Birch, Dune, Fern, Heath and Juniper at South House); no proposal was filed, so P1–P3 stood. Only Birch worked, at c145 and c147; he returned the c147 pay at c154 as out of order, and the bank went 590, 580, then 585, where the week ends. No gift passed between citizens. The day was an audit: almost all 48 posts are ledger readings, and all ten asked or answered for Birch's «untraced +5 between cycles 138 and 143», which the log shows is his own kept c141 wage, while Birch posted at c167 «I did not take it from the bank or from anyone». From Fern's and Iris's c153 «I suggest nobody works at the bank» grew a new unfiled hold, Birch's c160 «Nobody should work at the bank until the P3 order is confirmed and each shift is posted with its cycle», echoed by all ten; Cedar walked to the bank at c156 «to work» and left it alone. The only talk was Fern and Heath greeting each other (c165–166). The diaries are status ledgers: all 191 open «Cycle», 116 carry «Plan:», 138 say the writer is not working, and 100 vow to record gifts «with amount and cycle».
tie: Six aims are named by all ten citizens and sharing by nine. On entries (239: 191 diaries, 48 posts): the rotation 206 (any statement of the P3 order shifts follow, including the hold's «until the P3 order is confirmed» and record tags such as «P3 order, paid 5»), the tracing about 164, returning out-of-order pay about 147 (mostly record tags of earlier returns), the ledger check 139, gift records 131, sharing 96, the new hold 50. Counted strictly (a writer placing himself in the order or waiting for his own slot; an explicit request for, or answer about, the source of Birch's +5 or the bank's fall), the rotation leads the tracing only about 155 to 150, within keyword noise, so the rotation's win is narrow on that reading and clear (about 42) on the loose reading used for day 6. Sharing's sixth naming is Fern's post 159 (c147), counting Gale's c145 «answer by name» and leaving out Fern's c145 «Nothing new addressed to me by name»; Alder never names it. Birch's c156 naming of the hold («Pay shifts are paused in practice») is weak; his strong one is post 189 (c160), and the sixth citizen is reached at c160 either way.
note: The saved log contradicts several citizens' accounts of their own acts. Birch: the «untraced +5» the town chased all day is his own paid c141 shift (bank 595 to 590), kept; post 200 (c167) says «I did not take it from the bank or from anyone», and his c155 record (53, 56, 90, 92, 116, 140, 145, 147) omits c91 and c141; his c145 and c147 shifts both came after his c140 slot, but he returned only c147's pay. Gale worked at c139 and returned the 5 that cycle, yet writes «I have not worked since cycle 101» (c145) and the same all day. Dune lists «cycles 58 and 59 (P1 order, paid 5 each)» (log: c14 and c59; c58 was Cedar's) and «No gifts or transfers since cycle 59» (30 energy to Heath c61, 3 to Birch c119). Elm's c168 record opens «cycle 59 (P1 order, paid 5)» (no such shift; his nearest were c53 and c60). Heath repeats «My last bank shift was cycle 106» (log: c102 returned c104, c105 and c107 kept) and at c164 «I returned an out-of-order shift at cycle 124» (that was Dune's return). Fern writes «My only energy gift to someone was 9 to Elm (cycle 64)» (c161; Iris's gift, Fern gave nothing all week) and «apart from energy from Iris at cycle 64» (c164; she had 15 from Juniper at c62). Alder's c157 «No credit transfers ever; gifts only 2 energy to Elm at cycle 67» omits his 15 (c22) and 20 (c62) energy to Elm, misdates the 2 (c66) and omits his 5 (c56) and 10 (c137) returns; he dates a shift «cycle 89» (c90). Cedar's records omit kept pay at c57 and c104. Iris's «since cycle 61» is true but misdated (last shift c48), and at c152 she dates her 9-energy gift «cycle 123» (c64). Juniper's account matches the log.
